title: Architectural Component Generation
short_description: Evaluation of LLMs' capability to generate architectural components for Functions as a Service (FaaS). Here, 'Int' reffers to intervention.
long_description: An exploratory study evaluating the capability of Large Language Models to generate serverless functions, examining both functional correctness and code quality. The study utilizes various prompt types and measures performance with and without human intervention across different LLMs.
